added.title: Director, Engineering
added.description:
The Director, Engineering will direct, set goals, institute operational policies, and coordinate activities of the engineering department to include the design, manufacture, and testing of components and products, and maintain quality standards, specifications and systems by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors and employees. The selected candidate will establish best practices that will provide support for FAA FAR component repair solutions, develop DER repairs, and have involvement with multiple aspects of the FAA FAR-145 component repair process.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Directs department activities and develops policies to design new products, modify existing designs, improve production techniques, and overall product quality associated with manufacturing and testing.
Resolves problems using solutions that involve new techniques, technologies, or concepts.
Analyzes technology trends, human resource needs, and market demand to plan projects.
Confers with management, production, and marketing staff to determine engineering feasibility, cost effectiveness, and customer demands for new and existing products.
Forecasts operating costs of department and directs preparation of budget requests.
Advises management of new developments which may affect profit, schedule, costs, customer relations, and/or inter-departmental relations.
Provides direction and example for interpretation and application of company policies and procedures to the engineering activities.
Maintains a working knowledge of new technologies which may improve operations and develops recommendations accordingly.
Maintains a working knowledge of safety policies and regulations to ensure duties of self and others are performed in a safe manner.
Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
Other duties as assigned.

Education

Bachelor of Science degree required, Aerospace or mechanical engineering.
Masters degree preferred.

Experience

Related work experience shall be a minimum of 10 years with at least 5 to 10 years of management role over engineering department.
Experience with the policies and procedures of the following regulatory agencies; FAA, EASA, and DOT, relative to Aircraft Fire Suppression and Safety Systems including Oxygen and Stored Energy Systems.
Candidate must have strong Mechanical engineering skills with experience of exotic Stainless Steels and related processes such as forming and welding. Experience in a short run production environment is also a job requirement.

Qualifications

Proven leadership and management experience to lead engineering teams.
Strategic mindset with regard to NPD planning.
Proven team player who has demonstrated capabilities in the following areas: excellent communication, presentation, leadership and interpersonal skills, well developed problem-solving skills; solid organizational skills; and the demonstrated ability to be self-directed and effectively relate to all levels of an organization.
Looking for a hands-on individual with the ability to see the big picture.
Ability to work well under pressure, multitask and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to set goals and objectives to meet Business expectations.
The right person will be ambitious and flexible who wants to learn and grow professionally.
Must read, write, and speak English fluently.

Direct Reports

5-10 direct reports

Typical Working Conditions

Work will be conducted mostly indoors in an office type environment.
Exposure to heat or cold will mostly be limited to when walking from one building to another. The use of PPE such as safety glasses and safety toed shoes are required in designated working areas.

Essential Physical Tasks

Must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.
Regularly required to sit or stand, walk, bend, and reach with hands and arms
Regular use of hands/fingers for handling, holding, grasping and typing on a computer keyboard
The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus

Other

Due to contracts with the United States Government, the candidate must be either a US Citizen or Green card holder
Travel: 10-15% as position may travel to other Midwest or North American MRO business or customer locations

Business Unit

The AMETEK Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) Group is a global provider of third-party maintenance repair and overhaul (MRO) services for commercial, regional, general aviation and rotor-wing aircraft. It offers a wide range of services, including avionics, fuel and fluid systems, heat transfer, hydraulics, oil, oxygen, power generation, pneumatics, radios, and safety equipment. AMETEK MRO businesses are AEM, Aeromedic, Ameron, Antavia, Avtech, B&S Aircraft, Drake Air, Muirhead Avionics, Southern Aeroparts, AMETEK MRO Florida and AMETEK Singapore. Its operations are FAA, EASA, CAAC and CAAS approved.
The pursuit of innovation and excellence are the driving force at AMETEK MRO. For decades, our businesses have served the MRO market offering total solutions. With a focus on innovation, performance and integrity, AMETEK MRO is well positioned in highly competitive market segments to expect continued business growth. Supporting this growth are our eleven certified repair centers and over 700 employees across the globe.

BUSINESS UNIT: DRAKE AIR

Drake Air is a leading FAA/EASA/CAAC/AS9110C/AS9100D certified repair station specializing in the maintenance, repair and overhaul of Heat Transfer Components (Heat Exchangers, Pre Coolers, Oil Coolers, Fuel Heaters and Accessory items) for all types of commercial, regional, general aviation, military and rotor wing aircraft. Innovation has been a cornerstone to Drake Air's success, as best reflected in our core replacement program called Nu-Matrix™. With Nu-Matrix the old core matrix is replaced using an FAA approved process, restoring the unit back to zero time and in full compliance with the Original Equipment Manufacturers specifications. Nu-Matrix has proven to provide customer's the same performance, reliability and service life of an OEM new unit for much less than the cost of a new part replacement. Drake Air’s highly skilled engineering and technical departments consistently provide repair alternatives that provide our customers excellent value and significant cost savings.
Acquired by AMETEK in 2008, Drake Air is a unit within AMETEK MRO’s Division, a recognized global provider of third-party MRO services to commercial, regional and general aviation customers as well as military, helicopter and business jet markets.
Website: www.drakeair.com

BUSINESS UNIT: SOUTHERN AEROPARTS

Southern Aeroparts (SAI) is an AS9110C and AS9100D certified repair station providing a broad range of maintenance, repair and overhaul services for commercial aircraft components. These services include electromechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic capabilities for all types of electric motors, cargo drives and actuators; fan reverser, flight control and landing gear actuation components; and pneumatic motors and valves. Additionally, SAI maintains a repair rather than replace mentality. Utilizing our full, in-house engineering and manufacturing capabilities and upon customer acceptance, SAI uses FAA/PMA approved parts and DER repairs. This approach allows SAI to continuously provide the cost-effective repairs to our customer base.
Located in Tulsa, OK, Southern Aeroparts maintains a repair rather than replace mentality. Utilizing full, in-house engineering and manufacturing capabilities, SAI is able to continuously provide innovative, cost-effective repairs.
Acquired by AMETEK in 2006, Southern Aeroparts is a unit within AMETEK MRO’s Division, a recognized global provider of third-party MRO services to commercial, regional and general aviation customers as well as military, helicopter and business jet markets.
Website: www.southernaeroparts.com

BUSINESS UNIT: B&S AIRCRAFT

AMETEK MRO B&S Aircraft Parts and Accessories, a Class I, II and III repair station with an Unlimited Rating from the FAA, is a recognized industry leader in starter generators, inverters, fuel systems, boost pumps and much more. B&S supports the business and general aviation markets, the US Military, commercial air carriers as well as rotor wing operators. Additionally, B&S has been chosen as the authorized repair center for a number of leading aircraft manufacturers such as Hawker Beechcraft, Cessna Aircraft and Pilatus.
Acquired by AMETEK in 2007, B&S Aircraft is a unit within AMETEK MRO’s Division, a recognized global provider of third-party MRO services to commercial, regional and general aviation customers as well as military, helicopter and business jet markets.
www.bsaircraft.com

added.description:
Fast Growing Electonics Manufacturing Operation in Beaverton seeks an expeirenced Director of Engineering to join the leadership team. This is a key role that will oversee a team of 20-25 Engineers, including Manufacturing, Process, and Test Engineers. Qualified candidates should have prior experience in a PCBA manufacturing environment with knowledge of Surface Mount Techology. The company has doubled in size over the past 3 years with projects for signficantly more growth in the years ahead due to increased demand in the Defense and Space Industry. Awesome culture and great benefits.

Engineering Leadership & Team Management

Lead and direct the Engineering Team, establishing priorities, assigning resources, and ensuring timely completion of projects and deliverables.
Develop, coach, and mentor engineering staff to build technical capability, accountability, initiative, and effective cross-functional collaboration.
Establish and maintain engineering processes, standards, and performance expectations that support safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
Identify staffing, training, equipment, and resource requirements and make recommendations to executive leadership.
Promote continuous improvement, Lean/Six Sigma practices, standardization, and problem-solving throughout Engineering and Manufacturing.

Technology Development

Develop and maintain an engineering technology roadmap aligned with strategic objectives, customer requirements, and industry trends.
Assess internal capabilities against current and future market and customer requirements and recommend investments in equipment, technology, software, and technical resources.
Evaluate emerging and disruptive technologies and identify opportunities, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Lead or support the selection, implementation, validation, and integration of new manufacturing technologies and equipment.
Maintain strong technical knowledge of PCBA manufacturing, SMT, high-level assembly, box build, test, and related manufacturing processes.

Sales & Customer Support

Serve as a technical resource to customers and prospects, working directly with customer engineering teams to evaluate designs, manufacturing requirements, and process improvements.
Partner with Business Development and Program Management on new opportunities, customer selection, and portfolio management.
Provide engineering input to quotations, including technology fit, DFM/DFT analysis, process requirements, tooling, equipment, and technical risks.
Evaluate customer designs and requirements against internal capabilities and identify opportunities to improve manufacturability, quality, reliability, and cost.

New Product Introduction

Direct Engineering's participation in the NPI process from quotation through production launch, ensuring effective transition of new products into manufacturing.
Establish and maintain robust DFM/DFT processes that support accurate quoting, manufacturability, quality, reliability, and cost objectives.
Oversee manufacturing process development, documentation, tooling, programming, and technical requirements for new products.
Ensure engineering support for quick-turn and complex product introductions.
Direct engineering support for component management, including regulatory requirements, declarations, obsolescence, and product lifecycle considerations.
Ensure Document Control provides accurate, timely, and controlled documentation for internal and customer requirements.

Operations Support

Provide engineering leadership and technical support to Manufacturing, Quality, and Process/Manufacturing Engineering teams in resolving complex production issues.
Lead defect review, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and process improvements for recurring or significant manufacturing issues.
Support validation planning and execution for processes, equipment, and manufacturing changes.
Provide technical direction for SMT, selective and wave solder, reflow, inspection, X-ray, test, rework, and other manufacturing processes.
Ensure engineering standards and processes comply with applicable customer, regulatory, quality, and industry requirements.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of experience in electronic manufacturing/EMS, including at least 5 years supporting new product introduction.
Significant experience leading engineering teams in an SMT/PCBA manufacturing environment.
Extensive knowledge of PCBA processes, high-level assemblies, box build, and electronics manufacturing technologies.
Experience in a regulated industry such as aerospace, defense, medical device, or similar.
Demonstrated experience leading organizational change, process improvement, and Lean/Six Sigma initiatives; Black Belt certification preferred.
Strong project management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Customer-facing experience with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to customers, suppliers, and internal teams.
Strong understanding of SMT equipment and processes, including printing, SPI, pick-and-place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, selective solder, and wave solder.
Experience with DFM/DFT, stencil design, reflow profiling, defect analysis, root cause analysis, and rework processes.
Working knowledge of IPC and J-STD requirements; Class 1-3 IPC training preferred.
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications.
Understanding of business finance and the financial impact of engineering decisions.

added.description:

Covista is the parent company of American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, Chamberlain University, Ross University School of Medicine, Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine and Walden University.

Our colleagues come from a wide range of backgrounds, business, academia, healthcare, government and nonprofits, and are part of a culture where doing exceptional work and making a meaningful difference for students and society aren't separate goals—they're one and the same. This means creating an environment where colleagues can develop new skills, build careers that match their ambitions and see the tangible impact of their work on healthcare education and workforce development. Colleagues who deliver results and embrace new tools to work smarter are valued for their contributions. But what makes working at Covista distinctive is our impact. Our faculty and colleagues don't just support healthcare education—they shape it. This isn't abstract purpose work. It's solving real problems for real people in real communities while advancing careers.

We operate on a hybrid schedule with four in-office days per week (Monday–Thursday). This approach enhances creativity, innovation, communication, and relationship-building, fostering a dynamic and collaborative work environment.

For more information, visit covista.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

Job Description

The Director, Data Engineering will own and operate Covista’s enterprise data platform — the cloud data lakehouse, integration and ingestion pipelines, data contracts, the Knowledge Catalog (governance, lineage, and PII/consent controls), and the DataOps practice that keeps it all running. This role is accountable for driving platform best practices, optimizing resource capacity and utilization, and ensuring robust governance around platform reliability, cost, and technical debt remediation.

As a strategic technology leader, you will own the “trust” contract with every data consumer — partnering closely with Data Science, Data Reporting, Applied AI, and business and institution stakeholders to guarantee trustworthy, performant data across Covista, ensure platform health, and foster innovation through proof of concepts (POCs) and forward-looking architecture.

Strategic Leadership

Own and evolve the enterprise data engineering strategy across the lakehouse, integration, and governance platforms, ensuring alignment with business goals and Covista’s data architecture principles.
Establish best practices and governance frameworks for platform development, data contracts, pipeline lifecycle management, and the Knowledge Catalog.
Platform & Technology Management
Oversee delivery and operations across the cloud data lakehouse (BigQuery, GCS), integration/ingestion tooling, the Knowledge Catalog (Dataplex), and the DataOps platform.
Drive standardization and modernization of the data platform, emphasizing scalability, automation, and reusability.
Own the roadmap for platform reliability, cost optimization, and lifecycle management across data engineering technologies.

Delivery & Flex Capacity Management

Implement a flexible resource model (FTE, contractor, and nearshore) to support project-based pipeline work, run-the-business operations, and spikes in demand.
Manage intake and prioritization of data engineering work, ensuring efficient allocation of internal and external resources.
Partner with Data Science, Data Reporting, and business units to support delivery of enterprise initiatives and transformation programs.
Data Trust & Quality Oversight
Own the “trust” contract with every data consumer, ensuring rigorous data contract enforcement, lineage tracking, and PII/consent controls are in place for all platform releases.

Technical Debt & Proof of Concepts

Evaluate and manage technical debt across the data platform; proactively drive remediation efforts through actionable roadmaps.
Promote a culture of experimentation through lightweight POCs, testing the viability of new data technologies and patterns before broad implementation.

People & Vendor Management

Lead and mentor a diverse team of data engineers, data architects, platform administrators, and vendors.
Cultivate a high-performing, inclusive culture with a focus on continuous improvement and technical excellence.
Manage external vendors (e.g., Atlan, Fivetran), contracts, and performance metrics to ensure delivery expectations are met.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
Ten (10) plus years experience in enterprise data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture roles.
Five (5) plus years experience leading data engineering or data platform teams.
Experience in higher education, healthcare, or other complex matrixed enviroinments a plus.
Deep experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google BigQuery, GCS), data catalog/governance tooling (e.g.,
Dataplex, Atlan), and integration/ELT tooling (e.g., Fivetran).
Proven track record in resource and capacity planning, technical delivery, and operational excellence.
Experience implementing platform governance, technical debt remediation, and upgrade strategies.
Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to work across business and technology domains.
Demonstrated leadership abilities.
Strong project management, process, technical and financial management knowledge.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects and multiple employees simultaneously.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead the software engineering organization supporting Research and CMC Development. Reporting to the Head of Digital for Research and CMC Development (D4RT), this leader will establish clear engineering standards and operating rhythms, drive accountability and predictable execution, and build a high-performing organization capable of delivering reliable, scalable digital solutions that advance scientific research and development.

This leader will oversee full-stack application and integration engineering capabilities, leading and developing engineering leaders and senior technical contributors while strengthening engineering practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering experience with strong operational and people leadership. They bring the technical credibility to effectively lead senior engineers, evaluate system-level tradeoffs, and develop exceptional technical talent. While this is not a hands-on development role, this leader will bring strong systems thinking, understand the broader implications of technical decisions, and empower technical leads and other senior contributors to provide technical leadership across the organization.

The successful candidate will also have significant experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations and a strong understanding of scientific Research and CMC Development environments. They will understand the scientific context, workflows, ways of working, and cross-functional dynamics required to translate complex scientific needs into effective digital and software strategies.

Here’s What You’ll Do

Software Engineering Operations

Lead the evolution of the software engineering organization, establishing the leadership practices, operating model, engineering standards, and talent capabilities needed to support a growing Research and CMC Development digital portfolio.
Build and develop strong engineering leaders and senior technical contributors, enabling them to grow talent, delegate effectively, establish clear ownership, and operate at the right level of technical and organizational leadership.
Establish clear and consistent expectations for performance and career progression across the engineering organization, creating transparency around what strong performance looks like and how individuals grow in scope and impact.
Establish effective engineering operating rhythms and portfolio management practices that provide visibility into priorities, capacity, resource allocation, commitments, delivery health, dependencies, and risks, enabling informed tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity.
Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and ownership in which teams deliver against commitments, leaders address systemic barriers to delivery and meaningful improvements to engineering practices and ways of working.

Application & Integration Engineering

Provide senior oversight across custom full-stack application and integration engineering capacities supporting scientific and operational workflows.
Guide engineering strategy across commercial SaaS platforms, custom applications, scientific systems, enterprise platforms, and data products, promoting reusable APIs, services, integration patterns, and shared capabilities.
Drive simplification and sustainability across the technology landscape, ensuring applications and integrations leverage sound cloud architecture and engineering practices and are designed with reliability, observability, security, scalability, and operational support appropriate to their use.

Partner with Product Management

Partner with Product Management to maintain alignment across product priorities, planned initiatives, engineering capacity, and existing commitments, enabling effective resource planning and informed portfolio tradeoffs.
Bring an engineering and systems perspective into product planning, helping teams understand how proposed solutions fit within the broader digital ecosystem and when software engineering capabilities are needed.
Develop engineering leaders who can partner effectively with Product leads, while working across D4RT leadership to strengthen Product–Engineering ways of working, shared planning, and decision-making.

Partner Across Digital

Build strong partnerships across Digital, including Data Engineering, DevOps and Cybersecurity to navigate shared priorities and dependencies and effectively leverage enterprise platforms, data products, standards, and expertise.
Bring an informed engineering perspective to cross-Digital initiatives and enterprise technology decisions, understanding their implications for Research and CMC Development and constructively influencing approaches where needed.

Drive Scientific & Operational Impact

Build trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Research and CMC Development, developing a deep understanding of scientific workflows, development processes, data flows, and decision-making needs to inform engineering strategy and priorities.
Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous scientific needs into pragmatic, scalable digital solutions that improve scientific and operational outcomes.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

15+ years of progressive software engineering and technology experience, including 10+ years of engineering leadership experience with responsibility for engineering teams, leaders, and senior technical contributors.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant hands-on experience designing and delivering production software, with strong technical depth across modern software architecture, cloud-native engineering, full-stack development, APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
5+ years of modern cloud architecture and cloud-native engineering principles, with experience evaluate architectural approaches and tradeoffs across complex software environments.
10+ years of leadership experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations, with direct experience supporting scientific Research, CMC Development, Technical Development, Process Development, or closely related R&D functions.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling software engineering organizations, including developing engineering leaders and senior technical talent, evolving engineering operating models and practices, and driving strong organizational performance.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience with scientific and laboratory technology ecosystems, including ELN, LIMS, SDMS, laboratory automation, scientific data platforms, modeling or analytical systems, or related capabilities.
Experience integrating commercial scientific SaaS platforms within complex biotechnology or biopharmaceutical technology environments.
Experience applying AI-enabled engineering tools and practices to improve software development productivity, quality, and scalability, with the technical fluency to guide engineering teams on effective and responsible adoption.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for building and leading a team to deliver technology products and services that meet business outcomes. 10+ years of technology leadership experience in large-scale enterprise environments.

Experience driving platform modernization, cloud/container adoption, automation, and engineering transformation initiatives.

Experience establishing engineering governance, SDLC best practices, quality standards, and delivery management frameworks.
Proven track record of driving operational excellence, platform reliability, resiliency, observability, performance optimization, and service stability.
Strong experience managing technology risk, security, audit, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and regulatory requirements in a complex enterprise environment.
Ability to influence senior leaders and effectively communicate technology strategy, business value, risks, and investment priorities to executive stakeholders.

Set strategic direction while ensuring flawless execution.
Lead complex technology organizations through transformation and growth.
Develop future leaders and build organizational capability.
Balance innovation, scalability, governance, operational excellence, and risk management.
Create strong partnerships across business, product, architecture, operations, and engineering functions.
Translate emerging technologies and AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

Experience leading enterprise AI, Intelligent Automation, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), or advanced workflow platforms.
Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, RAG, Semantic Search, and AI governance frameworks.
Experience with enterprise workflow orchestration, business process automation, API-driven platforms, and cloud-native architectures.
Knowledge of modern engineering practices including Agile, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), CI/CD, platform engineering, and infrastructure automation.
Experience leading large-scale modernization programs involving legacy platform transformation and adoption of emerging technologies.

The leader will oversee an organization of approximately 220 employees and 300 contractors, with an annual technology investment of approximately $200M, and partner closely with the Liberty’s Office of the CFO community to translate business priorities into measurable outcomes.

Equally important is the ability to influence and challenge executives, navigate complexity, make difficult tradeoffs, and lead teams through sustained, multi-year transformation. The successful candidate will build a high-performing, inclusive organization and create clarity, accountability, and momentum across a broad ecosystem of internal teams and external partners. Make durable platform decisions that reduce structural risk, improve resilience, and compound value through 2030 and beyond, balancing near-term delivery with multi-year modernization
Ensure Finance system, technical, and product architectures stay aligned with business objectives

The Director of Engineering for IDEX Advanced Flow Solutions (AFS) is a senior member of the AFS leadership team, responsible for setting technical strategy and leading innovation across a diverse product portfolio. The Director leverages engineering talent, processes, and technology to accelerate growth, strengthen differentiation, and reduce time to market.

Our $115M+ growth focused business unit operates across two distinct revenue streams. This role oversees multi-disciplinary engineering functions including software development, New Product Development, sustaining engineering, and project management.

Define, own, and execute the product and technology roadmap for AFS in collaboration with Business Unit General Manager and other department leaders.
Lead technical due diligence and capability assessments for product acquisitions, partnerships, and internal development programs to support both organic growth and inorganic growth strategies across AFS.
Drive engineering change management initiatives to transition NPD and sustaining engineering teams from cost out–driven, long development cycles to agile, growth oriented development models that accelerate time to market while meeting performance, safety, quality, and cost requirements.
Establish and standardize engineering processes, governance, and development frameworks that enable a shift from component level products to integrated systems solutions capable of rapid adaptation to evolving market demands.
Design and implement the engineering organizational structure, role definitions, and talent strategy, including capability assessments, succession planning, and targeted hiring, to ensure the organization can execute current and future strategic initiatives.
Work cross functionally with pre sales and post sales technical teams to translate customer requirements into engineering solutions, support complex customer engagements, and resolve technical issues impacting product adoption and performance.

5+ years serving as the technical leader for engineering teams
